images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: final unlabeled interactive English-learning background, Scene 1 of a four-scene McDonald's restaurant lesson.
Primary request: A bright, warm, charming premium 3D children's-book cartoon of a spacious McDonald's restaurant interior. This is an educational cutaway panorama, 16:9 landscape, visually clear at high resolution. All objects and people must be large enough to identify, with open space around them for later HTML labels.
Style: polished rounded 3D clay-like cartoon, soft realistic materials, cheerful red and yellow accents, golden arches SYMBOL ONLY, welcoming daytime window light. Not photorealistic, not flat clipart, not infographic panels.
Characters for continuity: two Asian elementary-school children, one girl with dark brown bob haircut and teal top, one boy with dark brown short hair and blue top, accompanied by an adult woman with shoulder-length dark hair and mustard cardigan. They walk through the entrance at left. Friendly staff wear red polo shirts and dark trousers. Other customers and background children support distinct actions; never make one person do contradictory actions.
Composition: camera looks into a single coherent restaurant, wide angled overhead eye-level cutaway. Left: open glass entrance with family entering; nearby a tall self-service touchscreen kiosk showing FOOD PICTURES ONLY, with one customer using it. Back center: a long ordering counter, smiling friendly cashier, a clearly separate countertop cash register with touchscreen and visible cash drawer, customer holding a payment card at payment terminal, and a small orderly queue of waiting customers. Behind cashier: overhead food-picture menu boards with no writing; a clear open kitchen with two employees visibly preparing food, and a separate employee bringing a food tray from kitchen to counter. Side background left: enclosed glass playground with a visible small slide and children playing. Foreground center/right: spacious tidy dining area with several clearly separated tables and chairs, one empty neat table and a distinct chair unobstructed. Some customers eat at a table to represent DINE-IN. At right: a clearly different EXIT door, a customer walking toward that door carrying a brown paper bag containing TAKEOUT.
Critical food contrast: on a clearly visible foreground counter-end or demonstration table, show ONE COMBO MEAL as a hamburger plus a red carton of fries plus a lidded drink together on one tray; immediately beside it, distinctly separated, show ONE single hamburger alone on a small plate to represent A LA CARTE. Make these two alternatives large, separated and easy to compare. Do not put other food beside the single burger. This must be present in the image itself.
Visual vocabulary checklist: overall restaurant, entrance, exit, counter, cashier, customer, overhead menu board, full-height self-service kiosk, countertop cash register distinct from kiosk, table, chair, dining area, visible kitchen, employee separate from cashier, playground; bright illumination, tidy furniture, large airy area, friendly smiling cashier, busy but organized activity; family entering, queue waiting, adult paying, staff working, children playing; combo meal grouping, single-item à la carte alternative, dine-in seated patrons, takeout paper bag.
Text policy: ABSOLUTELY NO readable text, no English/Chinese letters or words, no numbers, no prices, no slogans, no vocabulary labels, no callout arrows, no watermark, no frame, no teaching diagram. The golden arches may appear as a familiar graphic brand emblem only. Menu and kiosk screens contain simple unlettered food images. No speech bubbles. No inset panels.
Quality constraints: coherent room geometry, correct human anatomy, clear small props, all listed objects visible, no cropped key objects, no crowded clutter, no ambiguous simultaneous actions. This is the real base image, not a labeled mockup.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: No-text base image for a clickable children's English-learning scene, scene 2 of 4.
Primary request: A bright, warm, cute polished 3D cartoon McDonald's interior, wide approximately 16:9. The family from reference image 1 is now happily ordering at the counter.
Input image 1 role: visual reference ONLY for restaurant style, red/yellow furnishings and the recurring family. Create a NEW camera composition at the ordering counter, not a duplicate of the reference.
Characters: same young girl with dark bob hair and teal T-shirt, same boy with short dark hair and blue hoodie, their mother with long dark hair and mustard cardigan. Natural childlike proportions. Girl speaks to the smiling cashier and chooses meals; boy points to FOOD PICTURES on the menu. Mother receives a red Happy Meal box from another employee. A separate background adult customer carries a tray away.
Scene/backdrop: Clear ordering counter, picture-only menu displays, kitchen behind. A main foreground presentation counter offers distinct neatly spaced food items that children can identify, each physically plausible on plain little plates, serving tray, cup or stand. Food items must NOT overlap or hide each other.
Required learning objects, all clearly recognizable somewhere on the counter or large picture menu: plain Hamburger (one beef patty); Cheeseburger (visible cheese); Big Mac (two beef patties and unmistakable middle bread layer); Chicken Burger (breaded chicken fillet); Fish Burger (square fish fillet); French Fries in red carton; several Chicken Nuggets; one golden oval Hash Brown; rectangular Apple Pie partly showing from plain sleeve; vanilla Ice Cream Cone standing upright in a cone stand; Sundae in a transparent dessert cup with sweet sauce; icy brown bubbly Soft Drink in clear cup; bright Orange Juice in clear cup; plain white Milk carton; red Happy Meal handled box with simple golden arch/smile graphic.
Visible states: hot fries with gentle wisps of steam, cold drink with ice and condensation, crispy crunchy golden breading/hash brown, sweet sundae topping, small child-sized fries serving. Gestures should clearly support choose, point, order, receive, carry, using separate people for incompatible actions.
Composition: Food is large and legible in foreground lower half; ordering interaction upper middle; background sparse. Enough calm gaps for website labels later. Eye-level oblique wide view, neither top-down catalog nor cropped close-up. Preserve simple bright lighting and cohesive 3D storybook style from reference.
Constraints: Absolutely no readable letters, numbers, words, English vocabulary, Chinese text, captions, speech bubbles, labels, arrows, callouts or watermarks. Menus use FOOD PICTURES ONLY. McDonald's golden arches can appear as a recognizable logo graphic without writing. Do not invent additional featured food. No customer paying in this scene. No cropped foreground food. Opaque background.
images.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied image minimally: add two gentle but clearly visible pale wisps of rising steam immediately above the foreground French fries carton at the left, to show the fries are hot. Keep the steam delicate and confined just above the fries, not obscuring any face or food. Preserve the whole existing wide frame, all 15 food items, the menu, the family, gestures, restaurant, exact positions, lighting and 3D cartoon style. No other changes. Absolutely no labels, words, readable letters, arrows or captions. Opaque background.

images.prompt:

Primary request: Same bright warm cute polished 3D cartoon McDonald's interior and recurring family from reference image 1. A NEW composition of the two children seated at a spacious restaurant table enjoying food, wide approximately 16:9.
Input image 1 role: style/family/restaurant reference ONLY, not an edit target.
Characters: girl dark bob/teal T-shirt, boy short dark hair/blue hoodie, accompanying mother long dark hair/mustard cardigan. Both children seated and happy. Boy holds a round burger above an unfolded wrapper and is about to take a bite; girl dips ONE piece from her chicken nuggets box into a little dipping sauce cup. Mother seated beside them drinks an icy brown soft drink through a straw. Hands/anatomy coherent.
Required objects on a roomy foreground table, all large and separately visible: red Tray holding some food; Cup; a Straw clearly inserted into mother's cup; a second loose round Lid beside another open cup; a clean white Napkin; unfolded Wrapper beneath burger; upright Paper Bag; open Food Box of nuggets; small Fork and Spoon lying separately near napkin; red Ketchup in a small open sauce dish beside fries; separate pale brown Dipping Sauce where girl dips nugget; round Burger Bun with visible soft interior; yellow Cheese slice and bright fresh green Lettuce visible between burger bun layers. Include a FULL red carton of French fries, small child drink cups and restaurant setting. No needless pile of duplicates.
Visible states/actions: happy smiling faces, round burger shape, soft airy burger bun interior, fresh lettuce, full fries carton. Sit / eat / drink / dip / hold have clear anchors. Use a child holding a burger, another dipping, adult drinking to avoid contradictory simultaneous actions.
Composition: table fills lower half and all utensils/packaging remain fully visible; children's faces upper middle; McDonald's red/yellow seating and golden arches logo graphic in quiet distant background. Mild overhead oblique view enough to see tabletop and cup lid. Food/packaging not obscured by hands. Leave calmer gaps around objects for later interactive website labels.
Constraints: NO readable words, letters, numbers, vocabulary labels, translations, arrows, callouts, speech bubbles or watermarks. Golden arches logo graphic is okay. No food labels or writing on bags/cups. Preserve reference 3D material, family clothes and facial identity; opaque background.
images.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Minimal educational clarity edit of supplied image: only adjust the hamburger held by the boy. Make a SINGLE layer of fresh bright green lettuce visibly extend from under the top burger bun, with broad recognizable ruffled leaf edges, particularly across the front and left side. The lettuce must be unmistakably a leafy vegetable at normal wide-image viewing size. Keep the yellow cheese slice and brown beef patty separately visible below it. Keep the burger's round soft buns, boy's two hands and gesture exactly coherent. Do not change any other objects, people, expressions, seating, framing, light, food, utensils, sauces, wrappers or restaurant background. Same cute 3D style. No words, labels, arrows or captions. Opaque background.

images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: No-text base image for a clickable children's English-learning scene, scene 4 of 4.
Primary request: Same bright warm cute polished 3D cartoon McDonald's restaurant and recurring family from reference image 1, wide approximately 16:9. A NEW view near dining cleanup and tray-return area after the meal.
Input image 1 role: reference ONLY for style, family identity, red/yellow restaurant fixtures, not an edit target.
Characters: girl dark bob/teal T-shirt, boy short dark hair/blue hoodie, mother long dark hair/mustard cardigan. One child pours a small stream of remaining drink into the dedicated recessed liquid-disposal opening, supervised nearby. The other child examines picture-only sorting pictograms and places an appropriate used paper item toward the collection bins. Mother returns a red tray to a visible tray rack. A separate uniformed employee wipes an adjacent table with a damp cloth. Background customers walk toward an open exit.
Required objects, all clear and separate: Trash Can with dark ordinary-waste opening; Recycling Bin with unmistakable green recycling arrows SYMBOL and picture-only accepted-item pictograms; Tray Return Station with stacked red trays and a rack above bins; Leftovers (few remaining fries/pieces); an Empty Cup upright on the return surface with its open empty interior visibly shown; crumpled Paper Wrapper; stained Used Napkin; Wet Cleaning Cloth held by employee with subtle water drops; Broom; Dustpan; Mop; Cleaning Cart; closed Trash Bag resting beside cart; Recycling Symbol on recycle bin; Exit Sign above exit using GREEN running-person/door/arrow PICTOGRAM ONLY, absolutely no EXIT letters.
States/actions and semantic separation: messy foreground table with leftovers/wrapper/used napkin; dirty stained napkin; visibly empty cup; another table already clean; visibly wet cleaning cloth. Pour (child with liquid stream into dedicated collection opening), sort (other child responding to pictograms), return (mother placing tray onto rack), wipe (employee on table), leave (separate distant customers through door). Do not make one child perform several incompatible actions. Cleaning tools stay with staff/cart, not in children's hands.
Composition: center-left sorting/return station, mother and children prominent, messy tabletop in near foreground, employee cleaning another table to the right, cart/tools in a quiet fully visible side area, exit far right. Functional, friendly and orderly restaurant workflow. Wide enough to show all objects without tiny props. Keep clear calm gaps for later website labels. No spills on walking floor, no dangerous mess.
Constraints: Absolutely NO readable letters, numbers, words, English/Chinese labels, captions, vocabulary, arrows as learning callouts, speech bubbles, watermarks. Symbol-only recycling and safety exit pictograms are allowed. Golden arches logo graphic allowed; no brand writing. Opaque background. Preserve style and family clothing/identity.
images.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Minimal correction of the supplied educational restaurant cleanup image: Replace ONLY the stained white paper sheet held in the teal-shirt girl's extended right hand with a small CLEAN EMPTY FLATTENED BROWN PAPER BAG, without food residue. It should clearly match the brown paper bag pictogram shown above the green sorting bin, so her sorting action follows that on-site pictogram. Keep her hand/pose and bin exactly in place. Preserve ALL other elements: messy foreground tray with stained napkin, crumpled wrapper, leftovers and empty cup; boy pouring liquid; mother returning tray; employee wiping wet table; all cleaning tools/cart/trash bag; exit pictogram and departing customers; camera, lighting, 3D style and frame. No words, letters, captions, learning arrows or labels. Opaque background.
